title: Indian Contract Act, 1872 — Section 66 (Mode of communicating or revoking rescission of voidable contract)

content.overview: Section 66 provides that the rescission of a voidable contract may be communicated or revoked in the same manner, and subject to the same rules, as apply to the communication or revocation of a proposal.
content.glance: Rescission of voidable contract — communicate or revoke like a proposal (ss. 3–5 rules).
content.study: Rescission of a voidable contract may be communicated or revoked in the same manner and subject to the same rules as apply to communication or revocation of a proposal (ss. 3–5). Current-law framing: apply proposal-communication and revocation rules to rescission of a voidable contract.

sections.heading: Same rules as proposal
sections.body: Rescission may be communicated or revoked in the same manner and subject to the same rules as apply to the communication or revocation of a proposal.

provisions.title: Mode of communicating or revoking rescission of voidable contract

examples.title: Communication of rescission
examples.body: A rescinds a voidable contract. Communication of that rescission follows the same rules as communication of a proposal under ss. 3–4, via s. 66.

hypotheticals.question: Are special formalities required to communicate rescission?
hypotheticals.analysis: Section 66 applies the same rules as for communication or revocation of a proposal.

misconceptions.trap: Rescission is effective only when formally registered or written.
misconceptions.correction: Section 66 applies the ordinary rules for communicating or revoking a proposal.

questionsAndAnswers.question: How should a Section 66 problem be analysed?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: I. Identify rescission of a voidable contract. II. Apply ss. 3–5 communication/revocation rules. III. Conclude.

examTips: Link to ss. 3–5 on communication and revocation.
